Name: Vivatma Visvajit
Description: Vivatma Visvajit meets Bei Bang-Wen in the Chapra jail in Bihar, India in 1860. He had been cut off from his chi (kundalini/prana) and his access to the Brahman had been thrown out of alignment. Ever since his lord, the Poet Emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar II, was exiled his kundalini would not ignite. He seeks to free his lord so that he can access his power again.
